## What this issue is about
This issue addresses the missing release notes and change log in the Aurora documentation for Plone. Sphinx, a documentation generator, reports warnings indicating that it cannot find the release notes, which are intended to provide users with information about updates and changes.

## What needs to be done
We need to add the missing release notes to the documentation. This will involve creating a new section or updating existing content to ensure that Sphinx can reference the release notes correctly.

## Helpful background
The issue was originally raised because Sphinx returned warnings about unknown documents related to release notes.
